profile.summary: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited produces and sells ethanol and other products derived from distillery processes and compressed biogas in India. Its products include ethanol, green hydrogen, compressed biogas, extra neutral alcohol, and fermented organic manure. In addition, it provides biofuel dispensing stations, CO2, sustainable aviation fuel, liquid fermented organic manure, motor spirit and high-spee
